title: image reslice imaging
explanation:
### Description

Test vtkImageReslice with reslice axes vs reslice transform, input sampling on/off.

**dataset → input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → scene → output**

- [vtkImageReslice](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageReslice.html) — image reslice.
- [vtkImageSlice](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageSlice.html) — image slice.
- [vtkImageSliceMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageSliceMapper.html) — image slice mapper.
- [vtkPNGReader](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPNGReader.html) — png reader.
- [vtkTransform](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTransform.html) — defines a 4x4 geometric transformation.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
